full_text: Revenue Management Solutions Appoints Patrick Nordqvist as Chief Technology Officer OKLAHOMA CITY--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul 24, 2026-- Revenue Management Solutions (RMS), a leading provider of healthcare remittance and revenue cycle automation solutions, announced the appointment of Patrick Nordqvist as Chief Technology Officer. In this role, Nordqvist will lead RMS’s technology organization, overseeing system architecture, software development, production operations, platform engineering, infrastructure, automation and artificial intelligence. He will focus on strengthening the company’s technology foundation, advancing its solutions and ensuring RMS can continue to scale with the evolving needs of its clients and partners. “Patrick brings an exceptional combination of healthcare expertise, technology leadership and hands-on experience building and transforming technology organizations,” said Scott Thomas, CEO of RMS. “His perspective will be invaluable as we continue investing in technology that creates meaningful value for our clients and supports RMS’s long-term growth.” Nordqvist has more than 25 years of experience developing technology solutions across the healthcare industry, including the payer, hospital and provider, revenue cycle management, pharmaceutical and Medicaid markets. Throughout his career, he has led enterprise technology strategies, launched cloud-based healthcare platforms, modernized development organizations and expanded the use of artificial intelligence, automation and data analytics. Before joining RMS, Nordqvist served as Chief Technology Officer at DCI Software/Acumen, where he led product and technology strategy for the company’s cloud-based Medicaid solutions. His previous leadership roles include Chief Technology Officer at Equality Health and technology executive positions at McKesson, RevSpring, NextGen and TriZetto. He holds a Master of Science degree from Chalmers University of Technology in Sweden. “I am very excited to join RMS and help further the company’s success and growth,” Nordqvist said. “RMS has deep industry knowledge, extensive data and a strong foundation for innovation. By combining those strengths with experience from across the healthcare ecosystem, we have an opportunity to develop solutions that bring payers, providers and patients closer together while helping simplify an often-fragmented healthcare landscape.” About Revenue Management Solutions Revenue Management Solutions delivers technology-driven healthcare remittance and revenue cycle solutions that help organizations reduce manual work, improve payment posting and gain faster access to critical financial information. Through advanced automation, artificial intelligence and deep healthcare expertise, RMS helps healthcare providers, financial institutions and technology partners simplify complex revenue cycle workflows.
